title: Standards: OAuth 2.x, OIDC and JWT/JWKS as vendors use them
goal: Client credentials, device flow, PKCE and token validation, mapped to the vendors and MCP servers that use each. Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
